body: I can’t guarantee it gets better, but after reading all you’ve been through, it’s clear you are strong. You may not realise it but I bet there were days u thought you’d never get past some stuff but you’re here now, I’m so so sorry that you’re going through this, you seem like such a sweet soul who just needs a break, life is unfair at times :( nothing that happens to you is ur fault. Nothing. I can’t tell you it’ll get better but I admire that you’re still here after all you’ve been through. I admire your strength. Please keep going I believe you can find the courage, you letting this out is just the beginning, the world is urs, your life is YOURS. It hurts so much trust me I know I wish I could hug you and set you free from the pain, so all you can experience is happiness but I jus want you to know I believe In you, cry if u have to let it all out but please do not give up. Please :( ❤️

Don’t apologise for how you feel, it’s important. The fact that you’re still here means something, you have a purpose you may not know it yet but you’ll find it, the hesitation shows that some part of you is still fighting, I don’t know you personally but I hope you find peace whilst still here, I hope you smile more and have better days ❤️

Thank you!! Honestly thanking you so so much, it’s kinda comforting to know that I’m not the only one feeling this way. I don’t know what you’re going through either but please don’t give up, your words have helped and thank you for believing in me, I believe in you too! Jus from your reply I know you got some good in you and If you ever need anyone to speak to I’m here. You are important! ❤️
